title: comms_setting
description: The CMS settings: one record for the whole product, edited in the Console (see CMS_GUIDE.md and COMMS_SETTING_GUIDE.md). The send mode (off, log_only, live) is not here: it comes from the environment with the secrets. Rules the schema cannot express: exactly one record exists (settings_key is always default); turning is_text_on on is refused until a text channel exists; from_address must be an address the mail provider has verified, or sends fail; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept. The record is replaced in place; the log keeps what was sent. (A written policy only.)

settings_key.description: Always default. It makes the one-record rule checkable, because ids are UUIDs. Required.

sender_name.description: The name people see as the sender, such as Launch. Up to 80 characters. Required.

from_address.description: The address mail is sent from. Optional; absent means the address built into the server. Must be verified with the mail provider. The final domain is parked (P-05).

reply_to.description: Where replies go. Optional; absent means the from address.

footer.description: A short closing line added under every email. Optional. Up to 500 characters.

test_redirect_address.description: When set, every message goes to this address instead of the real one and the log entry is marked redirected. Optional. For testing.

is_email_on.description: Whether the email channel may send. false makes every email attempt not_sent (channel_unavailable). Required.

is_text_on.description: Whether the text channel may send. Must stay false until a text channel exists. Required.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
